title: Density of the varifold weight with respect to H^n (Borel representative and lintegral formula)
statement:
Let n, l be natural numbers, U a subset of R^{n+l}, and V = v(M, theta) a rectifiable n-varifold in U (the contract structure RectifiableVarifold), with M := V.carrier, theta := V.mult, H^n := muHE[n] on R^{n+l} and weight mu := V.weight = (H^n restricted to M).withDensity (ofReal o theta). Put g := M.indicator theta : R^{n+l} -> R, so g = theta on M and g = 0 off M. Then:
(i) there is a Borel function g2 : R^{n+l} -> R with g2(y) >= 0 for every y and g2 = g H^n-almost everywhere;
(ii) for every Borel set S of R^{n+l} (MeasurableSet S) and every function phi : R^{n+l} -> [0, infinity] (not necessarily measurable), int_S phi dmu = int_S ofReal(g(y)) phi(y) dH^n(y).
Here int_S is the lower (ENNReal-valued) Lebesgue integral against the restriction of the measure to S.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), (∃ g : Amb n ℓ → ℝ, Measurable g ∧ (∀ y, 0 ≤ g y) ∧ g =ᵐ[(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ))] V.carrier.indicator V.mult) ∧ ∀ S : Set (Amb n ℓ), MeasurableSet S → ∀ φ : Amb n ℓ → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ y in S, φ y ∂V.weight = ∫⁻ y in S, ENNReal.ofReal (V.carrier.indicator V.mult y) * φ y ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ))
